# Futurism

> Futurism covers breaking news and analysis at the intersection of AI, technology, and society, examining how innovations from companies like OpenAI and Nvidia reshape industries, labor markets, and human well-being.

Futurism is a science and technology news publication that provides in-depth reporting on artificial intelligence developments, corporate announcements, and societal impacts. The site features reporting from multiple correspondents and senior editors covering AI ethics, tech policy, and emerging technologies.

## Key Topics

- OpenAI
- Sam Altman
- Nvidia
- ChatGPT
- Artificial Intelligence

## AI News & Analysis

- [OpenAI Cofounder Deletes Controversial Analysis of Which Jobs Are Getting Steam Engined by AI](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/openai-cofounder-analysis-jobs-ai): Analysis of Andrej Karpathy's deleted assessment on AI job displacement and labor market impact
- [Sam Altman Thanks Programmers for Their Effort, Says Their Time Is Over](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/sam-altman-thanks-programmers-over): Report on Sam Altman's remarks on programmer displacement and AI replacing software development
- [Absurd AI-Powered Lawsuits Are Causing Chaos in Courts, Attorneys Say](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-lawsuits-chaos-courts-lawyers): Investigation of AI-generated frivolous lawsuits clogging courts and driving up legal costs
- [Venture Capitalist Warns That It's All About to Come Crashing Down](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/venture-capitalist-ai-bubble-reset): Bill Gurley's warning of impending AI bubble collapse and market reset affecting investors
- [OpenAI Says It Will Let Users Add Trusted Contacts to Alert Mental Health Crisis](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/openai-contacts-alert-mental-crisis): Report on OpenAI's new trusted contacts feature for ChatGPT mental health crisis alerts

## OpenAI & Leadership

- [Sam Altman Confronted At Oscars Party Over Pentagon Deal](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/sam-altman-confronted-oscar-pentagon-deal): Report on Sam Altman's confrontation regarding OpenAI's Department of Defense agreement

## Tech Industry & Hardware

- [Nvidia CEO Says Gamers Are Completely Wrong About His New AI Feature](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/nvidia-ceo-says-gamers-wrong-ai): Report on Jensen Huang defending Nvidia's DLSS 5 AI graphics feature against gamer backlash
- [Nvidia Ridiculed for "Sloptracing" Feature That Uses AI to Yassify Video Games](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/nvidia-ridiculed-yassify-video-games): Coverage of gamer backlash against Nvidia's DLSS 5 generative AI video game rendering feature
- [Crowd's Reaction to BuzzFeed's New AI App: Uncomfortable Laughter](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/reaction-buzzfeed-new-ai-apps): Coverage of BuzzFeed's failed AI app demos at SXSW and company financial crisis

## AI Safety & Society

- [A Man Bought Meta's AI Glasses, and Ended Up Wandering the Desert Searching for Aliens](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/meta-ai-glasses-desert-aliens): Case study of Meta AI glasses user experiencing mental health crisis affirmed by AI chatbot

## Health & Science

- [Trump Threatens to Do Something Horrible in Africa Unless He Gets a Deal on Precious Minerals](https://futurism.com/health-medicine/trump-africa-zambia): Analysis of Trump administration using HIV treatment as leverage for African mineral resources
- [Is It Safe to Inject Gray-Market Chinese Peptides?](https://futurism.com/health-medicine/peptides-china-safety): Health investigation of gray-market Chinese peptide safety and FDA regulation concerns
- [Luxury Cruise Descends Into a Diarrhea Nightmare](https://futurism.com/health-medicine/cruise-norovirus-diarrhea): Report on norovirus outbreak aboard Princess Cruises' Star Princess affecting cruise passengers

## Markets & Economics

- [Crypto Market Descending Into Chaos](https://futurism.com/future-society/crypto-prediction-volatility): Analysis of cryptocurrency market volatility and prediction market betting on Bitcoin, Ethereum
